cues.en: So up until now, we learned that strings can be accessed quite easily.
cues.zh: 目前學到，存取字串很容易。

cues.en: And using the square brackets, we can access different parts of the string.
cues.zh: 使用中括號，就能存取字串的不同部分。

cues.en: And this idea of a start, a stop and a step over is what we call slicing or string slicing, because
cues.zh: start、stop、step 這種寫法，叫切片，也就是字串切片，

cues.en: we can slice the string however we like.
cues.zh: 因為能依需要切出字串。

cues.en: But we also need to learn another important term that's going to come up again and again throughout this course.
cues.zh: 但還需要學另一個重要術語，整門課會一再出現。

cues.en: And as a matter of fact, it's an important concept that as you get more advanced into programming, you really need to understand what is this concept?
cues.zh: 而且，隨著程式設計程度提高，你真的必須理解這個重要概念。是什麼呢？

cues.en: Well, it's this idea of immutability.
cues.zh: 就是不可變性。

cues.en: It's an important term in programming.
cues.zh: 這是程式設計的重要術語。

cues.en: What does immutability mean?
cues.zh: 不可變性是什麼意思？

cues.en: Well, strings and python are immutable.
cues.zh: Python 的字串是不可變的。

cues.en: That means they cannot be changed.
cues.zh: 也就是不能被修改。

cues.en: What I mean by that.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，

cues.en: Now that we've assigned selfish this value, this string.
cues.zh: 把這個字串指定給 selfish 後，

cues.en: Well, I can reassign it, right?
cues.zh: 當然可以重新指定，對吧？

cues.en: I can say selfish is 100 now.
cues.zh: 可以改成 selfish = 100。

cues.en: And if I print selfish.
cues.zh: 再印出 selfish，

cues.en: And I click run.
cues.zh: 按 Run，

cues.en: That works.
cues.zh: 能運作。

cues.en: But if I instead do something like the first index of selfish is going to equal eight and I click run.
cues.zh: 但如果改成，讓 selfish 的第一個索引等於 8，再按 Run，

cues.en: I get an error, I get a typo error saying string object does not support item assignment.
cues.zh: 就會出現 TypeError，說 str 物件不支援項目指定。

cues.en: Why is that?
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: Because strings are immutable.
cues.zh: 因為字串不可變。

cues.en: That is, I cannot change the value of this once it's created.
cues.zh: 也就是，一旦建立，就不能修改它的內容。

cues.en: I can just immediately change it to eight.
cues.zh: 不能直接把它改成 8，

cues.en: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven.
No, it has to stay the same.
cues.zh: 不行，原字串必須保持不變。

cues.en: The only way that I can remove this or change this is to completely reassign the value.
cues.zh: 要移除或換掉，只能把名稱重新指定給其他值。

cues.en: So that in memory Python removes all of this from our bookshelf of memory and instead just assigns eight
cues.zh: 講者用記憶體書架比喻，Python 移除原本那些格子，改把 8

cues.en: into the zero bookshelf and removes everything else because we don't use it anymore.
cues.zh: 放進第 0 格，其他不再使用的內容則移除。

cues.en: Now this idea of immutability is something we'll explore more and more, especially when we start talking about lists.
cues.zh: 不可變性這個概念，之後會繼續探索，尤其開始談串列時。

cues.en: But for now, just remember that you can't reassign part of a string.
cues.zh: 現在先記得，不能重新指定字串的一部分。

cues.en: Once created, it exists like that in that form.
cues.zh: 建立後，就以那個形式存在。

cues.en: The only way we can change it is to create something new.
cues.zh: 要改變結果，得建立新的東西。

cues.en: We can do selfish plus eight and we can create it that way.
cues.zh: 可以把 selfish 加上字串 8，用這個方式建立。

cues.en: But now this selfish is a whole new string.
cues.zh: 但現在這個 selfish，已經是全新的字串。

cues.en: This no longer exists, and a whole new shelf space was created for us to use this whole new string.
cues.zh: 依講者的比喻，原本的消失，另有一整組新的書架空間，存放這個新字串。

cues.en: Again, if this doesn't make sense to you or why it's important just yet.
cues.zh: 如果現在還不理解，或不清楚為什麼重要，

cues.en: Don't worry.
cues.zh: 別擔心。

cues.en: We'll get there.
cues.zh: 我們會慢慢談到。

cues.en: For now, though, I'll see you in the next video.
cues.zh: 現在先這樣，下支影片見。

cues.en: Bye bye.
cues.zh: 再見。
